reviewContext: President-authorized integration of Least Verified Action as the upper constrained optimization selector over SETKA causal, structural, computational, disclosure and materialization laws: stationary-action/Fermat/brachistochrone are retained as architectural analogies; admissibility is verified before cost; heterogeneous resource dimensions are normalized and weighted under a versioned contract; whole-horizon action can justify setup investment; Pareto filtering, bounded evidence, counterfactual branch comparison, delta replanning and sampled local stationarity are implemented as offline deterministic kernel primitives without touching Supabase/PostgreSQL
reviewedSemantics: Least Verified Action is an engineering optimization law inspired by variational physics but is not a claim that nature always globally minimizes one scalar utility; the physical stationary-action, Fermat and brachistochrone examples are architectural analogies only

the canonical selector is: among causally, safely, privately, authoritatively and technically admissible paths to an allowed outcome, prefer the path with the lowest verified total action under the declared cost contract

hard constraints are evaluated before cost and cannot be traded for cheaper compute, bytes, money, latency or any other resource; a path that drops required causal information, bypasses safety/authority, violates privacy or bypasses recovery/cryosleep gates is inadmissible rather than merely expensive

the deterministic action functional normalizes each heterogeneous resource dimension by a positive reference scale before applying a nonnegative policy weight; raw compute, bytes, seconds, money, energy or other unlike units are never summed directly

the v1 action form is A(gamma)=SUM_segments SUM_dimensions weight_k*(fixed_jk+duration_j*rate_jk)/reference_k and cost references/weights are part of the versioned decision contract rather than physical constants

supported candidate resource dimensions include compute, storage IO, canonical storage, network, AI, latency, energy, money, coordination, materialization and privacy exposure only inside disclosure bounds that have already passed the hard privacy policy

decision-relevant cost evidence is explicitly classified MEASURED, DERIVED_EXACT, ESTIMATED_BOUNDED, ESTIMATED_UNBOUNDED or UNKNOWN; unbounded or unknown cost evidence cannot silently win a consequential canonical decision because its numeric estimate appears small

deterministic action totals are derived and may be rematerialized, while nonreproducible external prices, observed latency, energy readings or other measurements become irreversible causal inputs when a canonical decision materially depends on them

whole-path action is evaluated over a declared horizon, so the locally shortest or cheapest next step need not win; one-time setup investments such as indexes, checkpoints, reusable deterministic primitives, connector setup or shared precomputation may be preferred when their verified integrated action over the horizon is lower
the brachistochrone lesson is preserved as an optimizer guard: shortest geometric/local path is not automatically minimum-time or minimum-total-action path

verified admissible alternatives are Pareto-filtered before scalar selection where possible; a strictly dominated path is removed, while an action tie or incompatible cost contracts fail closed to REVIEW_REQUIRED rather than inventing a winner
counterfactual branches sharing an immutable causal prefix are the preferred evaluation surface for uncertain or state-changing path alternatives before canonical commit

when a bounded causal delta changes only part of the cost landscape, replanning should recompute only the proven affected dependency/plan region rather than the whole route, connecting Least Verified Action to Computational Irreducibility

the local stationarity diagnostic compares verified neighboring plans through delta-action and can identify a sampled lower-action neighbor, but absence of a better sampled neighbor is explicitly not proof of global optimality

the deterministic v1 evaluator implements plan validation, admissibility assessment, evidence assessment, normalized action computation, same-contract checks, Pareto domination/frontier, least-verified-action selection and sampled local stationarity diagnostics
the new high-criticality least_verified_action kernel component is registered in Kernel Map, routed by Kernel Pulse and covered by the LEAST_VERIFIED_ACTION check group

Kernel Pulse review run 33764655367 executed syntax checks, KERNEL_HANDSHAKE, LEAST_VERIFIED_ACTION and MISSION_GATE; all 10 Least Verified Action tests passed, KERNEL_HANDSHAKE passed 8 cases, Mission Gate self-test passed 20 cases, no unclassified executable files were present, and MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED was the expected governance response to adding protected kernel mass

the five new protected LVA files were reviewed as justified kernel mass because they establish one shared optimization primitive and machine policy rather than multiple independent runtime services; future feature-specific optimizers should reuse this contract instead of duplicating it

this transition does not claim a global variational solver, autonomous production scheduler, live query planner or proof of global optimality; v1 is a bounded deterministic offline plan evaluator and governance contract

no PostgreSQL schema, Supabase writer, Edge Function, production fleet scheduler or cryosleep state was modified; all post-recovery backup, audit, handshake and canonical transcript gates remain authoritative
